assumptions: Projected user-intent-acceptance costs are packet-only and tool-free. Credits are explicit projections, not billing guarantees. Observed multipliers model a GPT-5.4-like or Sol-like 1x lane and an Opus-like 15x lane while preserving the 20 KB packet target and two-attempt maximum.

one-pass-gpt-5-4-selected.pricingAssumption: Projection only: GPT-5.4-like observed 1x multiplier for one packet-only acceptance call.

one-remediation-retry.pricingAssumption: Projection only: one remediation retry doubles the GPT-5.4-like observed 1x acceptance lane.

sol-like-observed-1x.pricingAssumption: Projection only: Sol-like observed 1x multiplier when explicitly user-selected for packet-only acceptance.

opus-like-observed-15x.pricingAssumption: Projection only: Opus-like observed 15x multiplier when explicitly user-selected for packet-only acceptance.
